meta.move: Long messages with curly quotes and a concession
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40. Owen found out about the zero from his phone, in the middle of class. Who decided it, and did anyone speak to him first?

I want to be fair to Owen. I compared the essay with his in-class writing from September 24: 380 words in 40 minutes, comma splices throughout, no quotations. This essay has nine quotations cited by act, scene and line, and none of those errors.
Forty minutes on a clock in September against a week at home in October. Kids improve, Hale, and they write better when nobody's timing them. Can I see both pages?
You’re right that the checker alone proves nothing. I’m taking it off the table. I’m relying on the writing and the version history.
Okay. I haven't seen either page yet, and you haven't said what the version history shows. Start there.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and a written confirmation that nothing goes on his record, along with copies of the pages you compared and the version history you mentioned. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, nothing on his record, and to see your documents; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: You gave her a specific, dated comparison with his own earlier writing, and that got her to ask to see the pages, though one piece of evidence she had not seen yet was never going to move her position.
What cost ground: You never answered who decided on the zero or why no one called home before it was entered, and you mentioned the version history without saying what it showed, which left her question hanging.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence did not get near that night, because no times from the version history were said, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked what the version history shows, answer straight away with its dates and times, and own entering the zero before the call home in a single sentence.
